blind.description: A stylized four-poster canopy bed made of dark stained wood with four turned corner pillars. The top features a framed canopy with a tan stretched fabric or wood ceiling and deep red valances. Deep red curtains are drawn back and bound with gold rope ties at each post. The bed features a curved dark wooden headboard, two cream-colored pillows, folded cream sheets, a maroon duvet/quilt, and a green accent blanket draped across the foot of the bed.
blind.from_above: A roughly square tan canopy top divided into horizontal sections, bordered by a square dark wood frame with four square-capped corner post extensions.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure, with a footprint approximately 5.5 to 6 feet on each side.

notes: curtains lean deep red rather than distinctly purple/plum
